left.en: Nuna and Benji wake up early.

right.en: The rooster was up even earlier.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Benji sit up in bed and open their eyes as morning light comes through the window; on the right a rooster stands tall on a fence post and crows at the sunrise, chest out, in the same sitting-up pose. right.en: The tiger stretches from nose to tail.

cover_scene: Nuna and Benji stand side-by-side, smiling forward, with a small giraffe looking up at them from the bottom left, a tiny raccoon peeking from behind Nuna, and a little koala perched on Benji's shoulder.
